text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The struggle born of mighty legs.
Jungle Pocket brilliantly overcame the lingering injury in her hoof, and...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: She's no longer just the demon of Tokyo! She's a demon in Sapporo, a demon in Kansai as well...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket! She has transformed into one of the most
terrifying demons in Umamusume history!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, we finally made it to the top.
To the throne of the legendary boss.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Come on, try and take a bite, you young lion cubs.
Just so you know—I'm strong, got it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after the first three years, she continued to
reign as the absolute head. Meanwhile—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Partner, let's stop somewhere on the way back.
And grab some grub, yeah?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm so hungry! I'm starving!
Follow me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her innocence remains unchanged.
Still childlike, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—on New Year's Day of a certain year.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hmm, the Golden Generation, huh?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"What do you mean? It's a magazine.
It's got an article about Umamusume generations."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The generation three years ahead of us
is called the 'Golden Generation', right?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Special Week, El Condor Pasa, Grass Wonder...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them is insanely strong, and on top of that, the field is ridiculously deep.
Guess you could call it a golden age.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"The generation right below that—two years above us—
was TM Opera O's 'Era of Absolute Dominance.'"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"It's the exact opposite of the 'Golden Generation.'
We've gone from an era of fierce rivalry
to an era where just one person dominates completely."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Every era has its own color.
If that's the case...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I wonder... how we look to others.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What color do their eyes see?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And for the New Year's calligraphy,
Jungle Pocket scribbled down her goal for the year
in her usual rough style.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hello, Pokke-kun. Doing New Year's calligraphy too?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Same for us.
And for my 'friends,' of course."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I see. You guys are getting back into top shape too, so it's about time we set some goals and get down to business.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Reveal yours first.
What did you write, Pokke-kun?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, of course it is.
My goal will never waver. Never.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "The Strongest!" this year, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Mine sounds similar,
but it's a bit different. Namely—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"The fastest." That is all there is.
It is transcendence, of all limits.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it over with my 'friend'.
What we are aiming for is—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...'The Peak'.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Makes zero sense to me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I don't know either.
But... my "friend" will be happy, so.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see. "The Strongest," "The Fastest," "The Peak."
The only thing I know for sure is...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Totally scattered, huh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's all in pieces.
So delightfully incoherent.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
And—your resolve to bet on your own path
hasn't changed, right?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we were certainly saved.
However—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It is ephemeral. I harbor no wish to live long.
I intend to devote my all this year as well.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Likewise. As long as I can catch up
to my "friend," nothing else matters...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
At least we have that in common.
Deep down, we really are...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Means we can only live in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"By sheer chance, I was able to keep running.
However, even that..."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"It's basically just a bonus. There's no way I'd ever live my life
compromising on anything. Not now, not ever."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Partner. We're both a couple of idiots who burn too bright
to shine for long.
Even so—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Can you... see it in your eyes?
choice_data_list: Yeah, of course. Dazzling more than anything else!
Yeah, of course. Brighter than anything else!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I see.
Then that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"I don't care if I vanish anytime.
I treat right now as everything, carving my way of life into the turf."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
We are... a blazing light.
And there is only one thing left to do.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave a mark on the hearts
of everyone watching—one they'll never forget.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: If we can manage that much, we're golden.
